privacy.metaDescription: What Cocktailist collects, why, and how to request it be deleted.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectIntro: Cocktailist collects the following categories of data:
privacy.accountDataBody: If you create an account, we store the email and credentials Supabase (our authentication provider) needs to sign you in.
privacy.pantryDataBody: The ingredients you add to your pantry and the recipes you favorite, so we can show them back to you.
privacy.guestDataBody: If you use the app without signing in, we create an anonymous session so your pantry and favorites still work and persist on your device.
privacy.aiDataBody: When you ask for a drink idea from your pantry, your pantry contents and prompt are sent to Anthropic, our AI provider, to generate a suggestion.
privacy.aiIpHashBody: When a guest (not signed in) asks for an AI drink idea, we keep a one way hash of their IP address for up to 8 days, only to limit abuse of that feature. The hash can't be turned back into your IP address, and it's deleted automatically.
privacy.analyticsDataBody: On web, once you accept the cookie notice, and on the mobile app, we send PostHog, our analytics provider, events for actions like searching, adding a pantry item, and generating a drink idea, tied to your guest or signed in identity. A search event includes the text of your search query. We do not track page views, clicks, or session recordings.
privacy.diagnosticDataTitle: Error and diagnostic logging (planned, not yet collected).
privacy.diagnosticDataBody: We intend to install error tracking (Sentry) to help us find and fix bugs. Once installed, this may include your IP address and device or browser information. This category is not collected today; this notice will be updated when it is.
privacy.deletingYourDataBody: If you have an account, you can delete it and its associated data at any time from the Account screen's delete account option.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to <email></email>.
privacy.ageGateBody: The age confirmation answer is stored only on your device.
